All expected files are present. Those other untracked `.pHive/` files (agent-complete, cycle-state, episodes, interrupts) are Hive framework runtime artifacts unrelated to this task, not something I created.

Both roles are complete. Summary:

**Teammate 1 (behavior specs)** — created `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/personal/mdostal-tools-hub/.pHive/epics/github-repo-crawler/docs/behavior-specs.md` (198 lines, 19 numbered Given/When/Then scenarios using real account data: 9 forks, 4 already-listed tools, self-exclusion, 4 real v1 candidates, 9 no-signal repos). Covers all six explicitly-requested cases: already-suggested doc skip, README fallback heuristic (coin-finder shape + badge lines), homepage→originUrl verbatim/omitted, missing GITHUB_TOKEN, missing SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN with `--write`, and zero-eligible-candidates summary.

**Teammate 2 (implementation)** — created `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/personal/mdostal-tools-hub/scripts/crawl-github-repos.mjs`, implementing every element of the acceptance contract: fork/archived/self/already-listed(`repoUrl` match, hidden-inclusive)/`EXCLUDED_REPOS`-denylist/no-signal filtering in order; label humanization; `mount` slugification; description (GitHub field or README fallback skipping ATX headings, horizontal rules, blanks, and badge lines, joining wrapped paragraph lines); `originUrl` set verbatim from `homepage` or omitted; `hidden: true`/`live: false`/no `screenshot`; `tool-suggestion-<mount>` id namespace with existence-check-then-`create` (never `createOrReplace`); dry-run default, `--write` gate with fail-fast missing-token error; optional `GITHUB_TOKEN` header; graceful Sanity-config-missing warning in dry-run; summary table with all required verdict values.

I smoke-tested the script live against the real GitHub API (dry-run, no Sanity config) — it correctly enumerated 27 repos (26 + self), skipped all 9 forks, skipped self, and correctly derived descriptions via the README fallback (verified the paragraph-join logic against coin-finder's actual README). I also verified `--write` without `SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN` fails fast with exit code 1 before any network calls.

No changes were made to `next.config.ts`, `src/lib/tools.ts`, `src/lib/sanity.ts`, or `src/app/page.tsx`. No tests were added (matches repo convention).
